money.label: WATCH OUT
money.headline: Fresh-start spending sprees
money.body: A 1 year feels like a clean slate, and a clean slate can turn into a shopping list. Before any new-chapter purchase, wait a week and see if it still fits.
money.link: the 1's urge to start everything new at once

money.label: GO EASY ON
money.headline: Deciding shared money alone
money.body: In a 1 year it is easy to settle money questions by yourself and announce them later. Go easy on that: ask the other person one question before you decide.
money.link: the 1's habit of going it alone

money.label: AVOID
money.headline: Proving independence with spending
money.body: Spending to show you need no one can feel good for an hour. A 1 year may nudge you toward it; write down what the money was for before you spend.
money.link: the 1's need to stand on its own

money.label: WATCH OUT
money.headline: Pride over a simple question
money.body: You may notice a reluctance to ask how something costs or works because you would rather work it out alone. Ask the plain question; it saves more time than pride does.

money.label: GO EASY ON
money.headline: Paying extra to skip the wait
money.body: A 1 year is impatient with delay, and paying more just to move faster is tempting. Go easy on it: decide what the waiting would really cost first.

money.label: WATCH OUT
money.headline: Defending an old spending habit
money.body: When someone questions how you spend, a 1 tends to defend first and think later. Try saying 'let me look at that' and check the figures before you answer.

work.label: WATCH OUT
work.headline: Taking over the group's project
work.body: A 1 year pulls you toward the front of everything. You may notice you are deciding for others; name the decision aloud and ask for one other view before moving on.

work.label: GO EASY ON
work.headline: Starting more than you can carry
work.body: New starts are easy in a 1 year and finishing is harder. Go easy on beginnings: pick the one that matters and write a finish date beside it.
work.link: the 1's pull to begin without finishing

work.label: AVOID
work.headline: Waving off useful feedback
work.body: Defending your plan against every comment can feel like strength. Repeat the feedback back in your own words and keep the part that holds up.

work.label: WATCH OUT
work.headline: Doing it all yourself
work.body: You may notice you are carrying a task because asking feels slower. Hand one piece to someone by Friday and let them do it their way.
work.link: the 1's habit of going it alone

work.label: GO EASY ON
work.headline: Rushing a decision to feel in motion
work.body: Speed can feel like leadership in a 1 year. Go easy on quick calls: sleep on anything you cannot undo and decide in the morning.

work.label: WATCH OUT
work.headline: Insisting on your way
work.body: Stubbornness tends to sound like 'my way is simply faster'. Before you push, ask what the other approach would cost; sometimes the answer is nothing.

relationships.label: WATCH OUT
relationships.headline: Announcing instead of asking
relationships.body: In a 1 year you may find plans arrive as announcements. Turn one into a question this week and notice how the other person answers.

relationships.label: GO EASY ON
relationships.headline: Being right at any cost
relationships.body: A 1 year can make every disagreement a contest. Go easy on winning: say 'help me understand' once before you argue your side.

relationships.label: AVOID
relationships.headline: Pulling away instead of asking for help
relationships.body: Handling a hard patch alone can look like strength and feel like distance. Tell one person plainly what you could use from them.

relationships.label: WATCH OUT
relationships.headline: Taking feedback as an attack
relationships.body: You may notice a sharp reply forming when someone close points something out. Count to five and answer the part that is true first.

relationships.label: GO EASY ON
relationships.headline: Leading every plan
relationships.body: It is easy to pick the restaurant, the route and the time. Go easy on running things: let someone else choose once and keep quiet about it.

relationships.label: WATCH OUT
relationships.headline: Short patience with slower people
relationships.body: A 1 year tends to run faster than the people around it. Ask how they are doing before you ask where things stand.

energy.label: WATCH OUT
energy.headline: Starting hot and fading fast
energy.body: A 1 year can give a burst at the start and a dip in the middle. Pick a steady daily routine now, small enough to keep on a bad day.

energy.label: GO EASY ON
energy.headline: Powering through when tired
energy.body: You may notice you treat rest as something to earn. Go easy on that: put a short break on the calendar before the push, not after.

energy.label: AVOID
energy.headline: Skipping rest to prove you can
energy.body: Proving you need no break is a quiet form of pressure. Choose a stop time for each evening and keep it even if you feel fine.

energy.label: WATCH OUT
energy.headline: Running on irritation
energy.body: Impatience can feel like fuel, but it tends to burn fast and bring a short temper afterwards. Notice it rising and take two minutes away from the task.

energy.label: GO EASY ON
energy.headline: Too many firsts at once
energy.body: Everything in a 1 year tends to look like a good start. Go easy on the pile: choose two for this season and park the rest in a list.

energy.label: WATCH OUT
energy.headline: Doing the whole load alone
energy.body: You may find asking for help drains less than carrying it all. Name one thing someone else could take over and ask for it tonight.
energy.link: the 1's habit of going it alone

mind.label: WATCH OUT
mind.headline: Mistaking speed for certainty
mind.body: A 1 year tends to feel sure quickly. Before you commit, write one reason you could be wrong and read it back.

mind.label: GO EASY ON
mind.headline: Treating asking as weakness
mind.body: You may notice a story that needing help means falling behind. Go easy on it: ask one question this week and see what it costs. Usually nothing.

mind.label: AVOID
mind.headline: Dismissing ideas that are not yours
mind.body: An idea from someone else can feel like a threat to your lead. Write it down, give it a day, then decide.

mind.label: WATCH OUT
mind.headline: Needing to decide everything first
mind.body: The urge to settle every question before anyone else weighs in can crowd out better answers. Share a half-formed plan and ask for one change.

mind.label: GO EASY ON
mind.headline: Comparing your pace to others
mind.body: Being first can turn into worrying about who is ahead. Go easy on the scoreboard: note one thing you finished this week.

mind.label: WATCH OUT
mind.headline: Digging in on a first idea
mind.body: A first instinct tends to feel like a conviction. Give it a second look in a week before you defend it.

money.label: WATCH OUT
money.headline: Paying to keep the peace
money.body: A 2 year can make it tempting to cover a cost just to avoid friction. Say the amount out loud first and ask whether it is fair to you too.
money.link: the 2's habit of smoothing things over

money.label: GO EASY ON
money.headline: Dodging the money conversation
money.body: You may notice you put off talking about shared costs because it feels awkward. Go easy on avoiding it: book ten calm minutes and bring the numbers.

money.label: AVOID
money.headline: Keeping a silent tally of who paid
money.body: Quietly counting favors tends to turn into resentment. Say one plain sentence about what feels uneven instead of adding to the list.
money.link: the 2's habit of keeping score quietly

money.label: WATCH OUT
money.headline: Over-giving to be liked
money.body: Gifts and rounds can become a way to buy goodwill. Notice the urge, then ask yourself what you would do if no one were watching.

money.label: GO EASY ON
money.headline: Waiting for someone else to decide the budget
money.body: It is easy to hope the other person sets the limit. Go easy on waiting: write your own number first, then compare.

money.label: WATCH OUT
money.headline: Leaning on one person for every money question
money.body: A 2 year tends to hand decisions to whoever feels most sure. Try one small money choice on your own and see how it feels.

work.label: WATCH OUT
work.headline: Saying yes to every request
work.body: In a 2 year you may find your calendar filling with other people's priorities. Before you agree, ask for a day and check it against your own list.

work.label: GO EASY ON
work.headline: Waiting for approval to begin
work.body: The pull to check first can slow good work. Go easy on permission-seeking: start the draft, then share it for comment.

work.label: AVOID
work.headline: Staying silent about a real disagreement
work.body: Agreeing out loud while disagreeing inside can feel like peace and often builds distance. Name one concern in a calm sentence and offer a fix.

work.label: WATCH OUT
work.headline: Letting your credit slide
work.body: You may notice you pass praise along and say it was nothing. Say 'thank you, I worked hard on that' once this season.

work.label: GO EASY ON
work.headline: Reading too much into a short email
work.body: A brief reply can feel like a final judgment. Go easy on the guessing: ask one clarifying question before you decide what it means.

work.label: WATCH OUT
work.headline: Keeping a quiet list of who did less
work.body: Tracking unequal effort tends to sour a good team. Raise one specific request early, before the list grows.
work.link: the 2's habit of keeping score quietly

relationships.label: WATCH OUT
relationships.headline: Hinting instead of asking
relationships.body: You may notice you drop hints and wait to be understood. Turn one hint into a plain request this week and let the answer be whatever it is.

relationships.label: GO EASY ON
relationships.headline: Apologizing for things that are not yours
relationships.body: A 2 year can make 'sorry' arrive before you have thought. Go easy on it: pause, then apologize only for what you actually did.

relationships.label: AVOID
relationships.headline: Absorbing someone else's bad mood
relationships.body: Taking on another person's mood can feel like care and drain you quickly. Name it quietly, 'that is theirs', and do something that is yours.

relationships.label: WATCH OUT
relationships.headline: Waiting to be asked what you want
relationships.body: Wanting people to notice can slide into resentment when they do not. State one preference before anyone asks.

relationships.label: GO EASY ON
relationships.headline: Smoothing over every tension
relationships.body: Peace at any price tends to keep real topics off the table. Go easy: let one mild disagreement stand for a few minutes.

relationships.label: WATCH OUT
relationships.headline: Being hurt by a passing remark
relationships.body: A casual comment may sting longer than it should. Ask 'what did you mean by that?' before you decide it was unkind.

energy.label: WATCH OUT
energy.headline: Giving until nothing is left
energy.body: A 2 year tends to make helping feel automatic. Schedule one block each week that belongs to no one else, and defend it.

energy.label: GO EASY ON
energy.headline: Ignoring your need for quiet
energy.body: You may notice you skip time alone to keep everyone comfortable. Go easy on that: protect twenty minutes of silence a day.

energy.label: AVOID
energy.headline: Staying up replaying small remarks
energy.body: Going over a conversation late into the evening can cost sleep and rarely changes it. Write the worry down and decide to look at it in the morning.

energy.label: WATCH OUT
energy.headline: Skipping breaks to keep others at ease
energy.body: It is easy to stay on until the room is happy. Take your break first and let the room manage for ten minutes.

energy.label: GO EASY ON
energy.headline: Agreeing to plans you do not want
energy.body: Saying yes to dodge an awkward moment can cost a whole evening. Go easy: answer 'let me check' and decide in an hour.

energy.label: WATCH OUT
energy.headline: Letting others set your pace
energy.body: You may find you adapt to everyone's speed but your own. Choose one daily task and do it at your own rhythm.

mind.label: WATCH OUT
mind.headline: Circling a decision
mind.body: Weighing every side can turn into avoiding the choice. Set a decision time, pick the better of two, and let it stand for a week.

mind.label: GO EASY ON
mind.headline: Guessing what everyone else wants
mind.body: A 2 year tends to run on mind-reading. Go easy on guessing: ask one person what they actually prefer.
mind.link: the 2's habit of reading others first

mind.label: AVOID
mind.headline: Rewriting a message again and again
mind.body: Editing a note ten times often makes it less honest, not more. Send the second draft and let it be good enough.

mind.label: WATCH OUT
mind.headline: Looking for a sign from others
mind.body: You may wait for someone else to confirm your choice before you trust it. Write your own preference on paper first.

mind.label: GO EASY ON
mind.headline: Second-guessing a kind choice
mind.body: After you decide, a 2 year can bring a round of doubt. Go easy: note why you chose it and check back at the end of the week.

mind.label: WATCH OUT
mind.headline: Adding up small unfair moments
mind.body: Quiet scorekeeping tends to grow in the dark. Pick one item from the list and raise it kindly.
mind.link: the 2's habit of keeping score quietly

money.label: WATCH OUT
money.headline: Spending to lift a mood
money.body: A 3 year can turn a flat afternoon into an excuse to buy something cheerful. Wait until the next day and see whether the mood or the item is what you wanted.

money.label: GO EASY ON
money.headline: Funding a new hobby before finishing the last
money.body: New interests are easy to start in a 3 year. Go easy on gear for the next one: finish a small piece of the current one first.

money.label: AVOID
money.headline: Picking up the tab to look generous
money.body: Paying for the table can be a way of performing warmth rather than feeling it. Ask yourself whether you would still do it unseen.
money.link: the 3's habit of performing instead of feeling

money.label: WATCH OUT
money.headline: Losing track of small recurring costs
money.body: Small charms tend to pile up unnoticed in a lively year. Set an hour to list what renews each month and decide what stays.

money.label: GO EASY ON
money.headline: Talking about a money plan, not doing it
money.body: It is easy to enjoy the plan and skip the first step. Go easy on the talk: write one number and one date.

money.label: WATCH OUT
money.headline: Charming your way past the tally
money.body: Humor can turn a split bill into a blur. Say the figure plainly once and let the joke come after.
money.link: the 3's habit of avoiding the dull detail

work.label: WATCH OUT
work.headline: Starting new instead of finishing
work.body: A 3 year can hand you a fresh idea every week. Pick the oldest open project and finish a small piece before you open another.

work.label: GO EASY ON
work.headline: Talk standing in for action
work.body: You may notice a plan feels done once it is described well. Go easy on the pitch: write the first concrete step and date it.

work.label: AVOID
work.headline: Joking through a serious meeting
work.body: A well-timed joke can ease a room and can also skip the real point. Hold the joke until after you have said the plain version.

work.label: WATCH OUT
work.headline: Promising more in the moment
work.body: Enthusiasm tends to say yes before the calendar has been checked. Answer 'let me confirm' and reply by the end of the day.

work.label: GO EASY ON
work.headline: Polishing the pitch, skipping the details
work.body: The story is easy to refine and the footnotes are easy to skip. Go easy: have one other person check the numbers.
work.link: the 3's habit of favoring the bright part

work.label: WATCH OUT
work.headline: Spreading attention across too many threads
work.body: A 3 year pulls you toward everything interesting. Choose three active threads and write the others on a parked list.

relationships.label: WATCH OUT
relationships.headline: Filling every silence
relationships.body: You may notice you talk to avoid a pause. Let one quiet moment stand this week and see what the other person says into it.

relationships.label: GO EASY ON
relationships.headline: Using a joke to dodge a feeling
relationships.body: Humor can keep the mood light and keep a topic closed. Go easy: say the plain sentence first, then smile.
relationships.link: the 3's habit of performing instead of feeling

relationships.label: AVOID
relationships.headline: Gossip as a way to feel close
relationships.body: Sharing a story about someone else can feel like closeness and tends to keep it thin. Share something about yourself instead.

relationships.label: WATCH OUT
relationships.headline: Charming around the hard topic
relationships.body: You may notice a skilled change of subject. Name the topic you are avoiding and ask for ten minutes on it.

relationships.label: GO EASY ON
relationships.headline: Sharing a lot, then stepping back
relationships.body: An open evening can be followed by a retreat that confuses people. Go easy on the swing: tell them when you need quiet.

relationships.label: WATCH OUT
relationships.headline: Performing the happy version
relationships.body: A 3 year tends to put the best story forward. Tell one friend how the week really went.
relationships.link: the 3's habit of performing instead of feeling

energy.label: WATCH OUT
energy.headline: Running on excitement, then crashing
energy.body: A 3 year can lift you high and drop you quickly. Plan an easy day after every big social one.

energy.label: GO EASY ON
energy.headline: Yes to every invitation
energy.body: Social energy is easy to spend. Go easy: pick two events a week that you actually want and decline the rest kindly.

energy.label: AVOID
energy.headline: Staying up late for one more story
energy.body: Late evenings of talk and laughter can feel energizing and take from the next day's mood. Choose a time to go home and say it out loud.
energy.link: the 3's pull toward the next bright thing

energy.label: WATCH OUT
energy.headline: Chasing novelty for a boost
energy.body: You may notice you reach for something new when the day dips. Try a short walk first and see if the urge passes.

energy.label: GO EASY ON
energy.headline: Skipping the quiet hour
energy.body: Quiet can feel dull in a 3 year. Go easy on avoiding it: sit with a notebook for fifteen minutes and see what arrives.

energy.label: WATCH OUT
energy.headline: Scrolling when you need rest
energy.body: You may find a feed fills a gap that sleep would fill better. Put the phone out of reach for the last half hour of the day.
energy.link: the 3's habit of reaching for stimulation

mind.label: WATCH OUT
mind.headline: Jumping to the next idea
mind.body: A 3 year tends to generate ideas faster than they can be tried. Write each idea down, wait a week, and pick one.

mind.label: GO EASY ON
mind.headline: Staying on the surface of a topic
mind.body: It is easy to know a little about everything. Go easy on skimming: choose one subject and read two pages deeper.

mind.label: AVOID
mind.headline: Comparing yourself with someone's highlights
mind.body: Other people's best moments can make your ordinary day look dull. Name one thing that was good about yours.

mind.label: WATCH OUT
mind.headline: Talking yourself out of finishing
mind.body: You may notice a clever reason the project no longer matters. Write that reason down and see whether it holds in the morning.

mind.label: GO EASY ON
mind.headline: Drafting messages you do not send
mind.body: A good message can stay in drafts for days. Go easy on perfecting: send the plain version.
mind.link: the 3's habit of avoiding the hard part

mind.label: WATCH OUT
mind.headline: A mood that colors every judgment
mind.body: Mood swings tend to rewrite how a plan looks. Wait for the same decision on two different days before you act.

money.label: WATCH OUT
money.headline: A budget with no room to breathe
money.body: A 4 year can tighten every figure until nothing is left for a small pleasure. Add one line for fun and keep it, even in a lean month.

money.label: GO EASY ON
money.headline: Checking the same figure again
money.body: Re-checking a number is reassuring and can turn into a habit that eats an evening. Go easy: check once, note the date, and move on.

money.label: AVOID
money.headline: Refusing every small treat
money.body: Saying no to everything that is not planned can feel disciplined and quietly joyless. Choose one small treat on purpose and enjoy it without a tally.

money.label: WATCH OUT
money.headline: Keeping a method that no longer fits
money.body: A 4 year tends to stay with the system that worked before. Test one alternative way of tracking costs for a month and compare.

money.label: GO EASY ON
money.headline: Treating a spare hour as wasted
money.body: You may notice unspent time feels like a loss. Go easy on filling it: keep one free hour a week with no money-saving task attached.

money.label: WATCH OUT
money.headline: Insisting your way is the only sound one
money.body: Stubbornness tends to dismiss other people's habits as careless. Ask how someone else handles it before you correct them.

work.label: WATCH OUT
work.headline: Working past the point of use
work.body: A 4 year can reward effort so reliably that stopping feels wrong. Set a finishing hour for the week and keep it, even when the list is not done.

work.label: GO EASY ON
work.headline: Defending the plan against all change
work.body: You may notice you hold the plan tighter when things shift. Go easy: ask what has changed and adjust one step.

work.label: AVOID
work.headline: Checking over other people's work
work.body: Redoing what colleagues have done can feel like care and often shows a lack of trust. Pick one item to keep exactly as they made it.
work.link: the 4's need for control of detail

work.label: WATCH OUT
work.headline: Dismissing an idea because it is untested
work.body: A 4 year tends to prefer what is proven. Try the new idea in a small, low-risk way for two weeks before you decide.

work.label: GO EASY ON
work.headline: Perfecting the formatting
work.body: It is easy to polish the layout while the real question waits. Go easy: send the version that is correct and let the polish follow.

work.label: WATCH OUT
work.headline: Skipping breaks to stay on schedule
work.body: The schedule can feel more important than the person following it. Put two breaks on the calendar and treat them as meetings.

relationships.label: WATCH OUT
relationships.headline: Turning affection into logistics
relationships.body: You may notice care showing up as lists and arrangements. Say one warm sentence out loud this week that has nothing to do with a plan.
relationships.link: the 4's habit of showing love through tasks

relationships.label: GO EASY ON
relationships.headline: Correcting how others do things
relationships.body: A 4 year tends to see the better method at once. Go easy on the correction: ask what they were aiming for first.

relationships.label: AVOID
relationships.headline: Being right at the cost of the mood
relationships.body: Winning a point about detail can cost an evening. Say 'you may be right' once and see what changes.

relationships.label: WATCH OUT
relationships.headline: Scheduling every weekend
relationships.body: A full plan can crowd out surprise. Keep one afternoon completely open and let someone else suggest what happens.

relationships.label: GO EASY ON
relationships.headline: Holding back feelings until they are tidy
relationships.body: Waiting for the right words can mean saying nothing for a long time. Go easy on perfect phrasing: say it in a plain, short way.

relationships.label: WATCH OUT
relationships.headline: Needing notice before any change
relationships.body: You may find sudden plans irritating. Tell people you like a heads-up and ask them for one small thing you can say yes to on the spot.

energy.label: WATCH OUT
energy.headline: Pushing through when you are spent
energy.body: A 4 year can make stamina a point of pride. When your attention is thin, stop for ten minutes before you decide the next step.

energy.label: GO EASY ON
energy.headline: Treating rest as laziness
energy.body: You may notice rest feels like falling behind. Go easy on that belief: schedule recovery as seriously as any task.

energy.label: AVOID
energy.headline: Keeping a routine that no longer fits
energy.body: A habit that served you once can quietly drain you now. Change one element of the daily pattern and see how the day feels.

energy.label: WATCH OUT
energy.headline: A week with no play
energy.body: A 4 year tends to fill the calendar with useful things. Put something purely enjoyable in the diary and do not cancel it.

energy.label: GO EASY ON
energy.headline: Sitting for hours on one task
energy.body: Narrow focus can feel productive and wear you down. Go easy: stand up and walk for five minutes each hour.

energy.label: WATCH OUT
energy.headline: Weekend work out of habit
energy.body: The habit can continue after the need has passed. Pick one weekend day that stays free of work and keep it.

mind.label: WATCH OUT
mind.headline: Black-and-white thinking
mind.body: A 4 year tends to sort things into right and wrong. Look for a third option before you settle on either.

mind.label: GO EASY ON
mind.headline: Staring at one detail
mind.body: A single detail can swallow an afternoon. Go easy: set a timer, then look at the whole picture for a few minutes.

mind.label: AVOID
mind.headline: Rejecting a new idea on instinct
mind.body: A fresh idea can feel like a threat to what is built. Write it down and revisit it after a week.

mind.label: WATCH OUT
mind.headline: Rehearsing what could go wrong
mind.body: Planning for problems is useful and can slip into dwelling. Write down two things that could go wrong, one step for each, and close the list.

mind.label: GO EASY ON
mind.headline: Refusing to stop at good enough
mind.body: It is easy to keep refining after the job is done. Go easy: write what 'done' looks like before you start.

mind.label: WATCH OUT
mind.headline: Planning every detail in advance
mind.body: Over-planning tends to take the room out of the day. Keep one part of the plan open on purpose.

money.label: GO EASY ON
money.headline: Big buys on a whim
money.body: A 5 year pulls toward novelty and quick exits. Before any purchase over your usual, wait 48 hours and see if you still want it.

money.label: WATCH OUT
money.headline: Chasing every deal
money.body: A bargain can feel like an adventure in a 5 year. Write down what you came for before you shop, and stop when you have it.

money.label: AVOID
money.headline: Paying for change just to feel different
money.body: Swapping things out can bring a quick lift and fade fast. Name the problem the swap is meant to fix before you spend.

money.label: WATCH OUT
money.headline: Subscriptions started and forgotten
money.body: New sign-ups are easy to say yes to and easy to forget. Set one date each month to review what renews and cancel what you ignore.

money.label: GO EASY ON
money.headline: Saying yes to splitting every plan
money.body: Group plans can multiply costs quickly. Go easy: ask the total first and decide whether the plan is worth that amount.

money.label: WATCH OUT
money.headline: Keeping every money option open
money.body: Avoiding a firm choice can feel like freedom and can delay a simple decision for months. Pick one option this season and write the date you chose it.

work.label: WATCH OUT
work.headline: Switching tracks midstream
work.body: A 5 year can make a fresh project more appealing than the one in hand. Finish the current stage before you move, even if it is dull.

work.label: GO EASY ON
work.headline: Skipping the dull middle
work.body: The start and the finish are exciting; the middle is easy to rush. Go easy: set a small daily slot for the unglamorous part.

work.label: AVOID
work.headline: Promising more than you can deliver
work.body: Enthusiasm tends to say yes to everything. Before you agree, write what it would take and decide from that.

work.label: WATCH OUT
work.headline: Changing plans without telling anyone
work.body: A sudden shift can feel natural to you and confusing to others. Send a two-line note when the plan changes.

work.label: GO EASY ON
work.headline: Juggling five things at once
work.body: Variety can keep you sharp and also thin your attention. Go easy: choose two priorities for the week and defer the rest.

work.label: WATCH OUT
work.headline: Keeping every option open
work.body: A 5 year tends to resist a firm commitment. Pick one direction for this quarter and write it where you can see it.

relationships.label: WATCH OUT
relationships.headline: Pulling back as it deepens
relationships.body: You may notice an urge for space just as closeness grows. Say plainly, 'I need a day', and name when you plan to be back in touch.

relationships.label: GO EASY ON
relationships.headline: Cancelling at the last minute
relationships.body: A change of mood can cancel a plan that was already made. Go easy on the late no: decide earlier or go for an hour.

relationships.label: AVOID
relationships.headline: Keeping things vague
relationships.body: Keeping what you want unclear can feel flexible and often frustrates the other person. Say one clear sentence about what you are choosing.

relationships.label: WATCH OUT
relationships.headline: Saying yes, then drifting
relationships.body: It is easy to agree warmly and lose the thread. Put the promise in your calendar the moment you make it.

relationships.label: GO EASY ON
relationships.headline: Hurrying through a conversation
relationships.body: A 5 year tends to move on before the other person has finished. Go easy on the pace: ask one more question before you answer.

relationships.label: WATCH OUT
relationships.headline: Chasing the new person over the steady one
relationships.body: New company can be more exciting than familiar friends. Reach out to one old friend this week and listen.

energy.label: WATCH OUT
energy.headline: Overfilling the diary
energy.body: A 5 year can be thrilling and tiring. Keep two evenings a week unplanned and treat them as fixed.

energy.label: GO EASY ON
energy.headline: Running on novelty and caffeine
energy.body: Stimulation can feel like energy for an afternoon. Go easy: pair each exciting day with a quiet one.

energy.label: AVOID
energy.headline: Skipping sleep for one more adventure
energy.body: Late nights and early starts can be fun for a few days and wear thin quickly. Choose a bedtime and keep it on most nights.

energy.label: WATCH OUT
energy.headline: Scrolling for something new
energy.body: You may notice restlessness drives you to a feed. Try ten minutes outside first and see whether the itch changes.

energy.label: GO EASY ON
energy.headline: Refusing any routine at all
energy.body: Too much variety tends to drain you. Go easy: keep one fixed anchor each day, such as the same morning start.

energy.label: WATCH OUT
energy.headline: Using comfort food to settle the nerves
energy.body: You may notice you reach for comfort food when restless or stressed. Pause for a glass of water and a minute of breathing before deciding.
energy.link: the 5's habit of reaching for stimulation

mind.label: WATCH OUT
mind.headline: Acting before thinking
mind.body: A 5 year tends to speed through decisions. Add a pause: write the choice and one consequence, then act.

mind.label: GO EASY ON
mind.headline: Fearing missing out
mind.body: Every invitation can look like the one you should not miss. Go easy: ask what you would actually be giving up by saying no.

mind.label: AVOID
mind.headline: Giving up when it gets dull
mind.body: Boredom can be mistaken for a sign that something is wrong. Keep going for one more week before you decide.

mind.label: WATCH OUT
mind.headline: Chasing the next thing
mind.body: You may notice your mind is already on what comes after. Spend one hour fully on what is in front of you.

mind.label: GO EASY ON
mind.headline: Holding every door ajar
mind.body: Keeping options open feels like freedom and can keep you stuck. Go easy: close one option this month on purpose.

mind.label: WATCH OUT
mind.headline: Mistaking restlessness for a calling
mind.body: An itch to change everything often passes. Write the urge down and look at it again in two weeks.

money.label: WATCH OUT
money.headline: Paying so you feel needed
money.body: A 6 year can make covering other people's costs feel like love. Before you pay, ask whether you were asked, and whether you can pay without counting it later.

money.label: GO EASY ON
money.headline: Gifts beyond what is comfortable
money.body: It is easy to buy a little more than you meant for the people you care about. Go easy: set the amount before you shop and keep to it.

money.label: AVOID
money.headline: Picking up the bill, then resenting it
money.body: Generosity with strings attached tends to sour. Pay only what you can give freely, and say so plainly if you cannot.
money.link: the 6's resentment when care is not returned

money.label: WATCH OUT
money.headline: Guilt spending on the family
money.body: You may notice a purchase that is really about feeling like a good parent, partner or friend. Wait a day and ask who it is for.
money.link: the 6's guilt about not doing enough

money.label: GO EASY ON
money.headline: A household budget with no slack
money.body: A flawless plan can crowd out an ordinary surprise. Go easy on perfection: add a small cushion line and let it be.

money.label: WATCH OUT
money.headline: Handling everyone else's money questions
money.body: A 6 year tends to turn you into the household treasurer for everyone. Hand one money task back to the person it belongs to.
money.link: the 6's habit of taking on others' load

work.label: WATCH OUT
work.headline: Taking on a colleague's tasks
work.body: You may notice you absorb extra work because it is quicker than asking. Name what you are taking on and what you plan to hand back.
work.link: the 6's habit of taking on others' load

work.label: GO EASY ON
work.headline: Redoing it to make it perfect
work.body: A 6 year can send you back to fix what was already good. Go easy: set a standard of 'good and finished' before you begin.

work.label: AVOID
work.headline: Staying late to smooth things for others
work.body: Covering gaps quietly can look like loyalty and tends to teach others to rely on it. Say what you can do within the day and stop there.

work.label: WATCH OUT
work.headline: Not asking for credit
work.body: Helpfulness often goes unnoticed. State what you did in one plain sentence and let it be seen.

work.label: GO EASY ON
work.headline: A yes to every small favor
work.body: Small favors add up to a second job. Go easy: say 'I can do that on Thursday' and mean it.

work.label: WATCH OUT
work.headline: Fussing over details nobody asked about
work.body: Attention to the small thing is a strength and can become meddling. Ask whether it matters to the person it is for.

relationships.label: WATCH OUT
relationships.headline: Advice nobody asked for
relationships.body: A 6 year tends to turn care into suggestions. Ask 'do you want advice or just company?' before you offer any.

relationships.label: GO EASY ON
relationships.headline: Resentment about uneven care
relationships.body: You may notice a quiet tally of who gave more. Go easy on keeping it: say what you need in one plain sentence.
relationships.link: the 6's resentment when care is not returned

relationships.label: AVOID
relationships.headline: Managing instead of listening
relationships.body: Fixing someone's problem can feel like love and can skip hearing it. Ask one more question before you propose a solution.

relationships.label: WATCH OUT
relationships.headline: Taking responsibility for other people's feelings
relationships.body: You may find you adjust yourself so others stay comfortable. Remind yourself which feelings belong to you.
relationships.link: the 6's habit of taking on others' load

relationships.label: GO EASY ON
relationships.headline: Hovering over how they do things
relationships.body: It is easy to stand close in case you are needed. Go easy: step back for a set time and let them finish.

relationships.label: WATCH OUT
relationships.headline: Waiting to be thanked
relationships.body: Unspoken expectations of thanks can sour a kindness. Give without a ledger, or say what you would like in return.
relationships.link: the 6's resentment when care is not returned

energy.label: WATCH OUT
energy.headline: Running on empty for everyone else
energy.body: A 6 year can make your own needs feel optional. Put one hour a week in the diary that is only for you and treat it as fixed.

energy.label: GO EASY ON
energy.headline: Hosting too much
energy.body: Welcoming people is a gift and can wear you thin. Go easy: pick two gatherings you want and decline the rest kindly.
energy.link: the 6's wish to look after everyone

energy.label: AVOID
energy.headline: Carrying the whole household alone
energy.body: Doing everything quietly can look like devotion and tends to exhaust. Name one chore and ask someone to take it over entirely.
energy.link: the 6's habit of taking on others' load

energy.label: WATCH OUT
energy.headline: Putting rest last
energy.body: You may notice your own rest is the first thing to go. Move it to the start of the day, not the end.

energy.label: GO EASY ON
energy.headline: Comfort for others, nothing for you
energy.body: You may notice you reach for comfort food when you have given everything away. Make one comforting thing for yourself before you feed others.

energy.label: WATCH OUT
energy.headline: Guilt about stopping
energy.body: Resting can feel like letting people down. Tell someone when you are off duty and keep to it.
energy.link: the 6's guilt about not doing enough

mind.label: WATCH OUT
mind.headline: Perfection as a standard
mind.body: A 6 year tends to measure the home, the meal and the event against an ideal. Name one thing that was good enough and let it count.

mind.label: GO EASY ON
mind.headline: Imagining everyone's needs
mind.body: It is easy to guess what others need and act before they say. Go easy: ask once before you arrange it.

mind.label: AVOID
mind.headline: Feeling selfish for resting
mind.body: Rest can feel undeserved when others are busy. Note that a rested carer helps more than a tired one.
mind.link: the 6's guilt about not doing enough

mind.label: WATCH OUT
mind.headline: Worrying on behalf of others
mind.body: You may notice you carry concerns that belong to someone else. Write them down and ask whether any are yours to act on.
mind.link: the 6's habit of taking on others' load

mind.label: GO EASY ON
mind.headline: Harsh judgment of yourself
mind.body: A 6 year can turn a small slip into a long review. Go easy: say what you would say to a friend in the same spot.

mind.label: WATCH OUT
mind.headline: Needing to be indispensable
mind.body: Being needed can feel like worth. Teach one person how to do one of your tasks.

money.label: WATCH OUT
money.headline: Researching a small buy to exhaustion
money.body: A 7 year can turn a modest purchase into weeks of comparison. Set a research limit of one evening, then choose the best of what you found.

money.label: GO EASY ON
money.headline: Waiting for certainty before any decision
money.body: You may notice you hold off until every unknown is answered, and some cannot be. Go easy: write the three facts you need and decide when you have them.
money.link: the 7's habit of waiting for certainty

money.label: AVOID
money.headline: Keeping money matters secret
money.body: Privacy about money is fine, and secrecy from the people it affects tends to build distance. Share one plain figure with the person involved.

money.label: WATCH OUT
money.headline: Distrusting every offer
money.body: A 7 year can make every deal look like a trick. Check one claim properly, then judge the offer on what you found.

money.label: GO EASY ON
money.headline: Collecting information instead of deciding
money.body: Reading more can feel productive and delay a simple choice. Go easy: write the choice and the date by which you plan to make it.

money.label: WATCH OUT
money.headline: Avoiding the dull money admin
money.body: Thinking about big questions can crowd out the small forms. Pick one practical task and do it before you read anything else.

work.label: WATCH OUT
work.headline: Working alone far too long
work.body: A 7 year can make solitary focus feel ideal. Share what you have so far with one person before it feels finished.

work.label: GO EASY ON
work.headline: Hiding half-finished work
work.body: You may notice you hold work back until it is perfect. Go easy: show a rough version and ask one question about it.

work.label: AVOID
work.headline: Analyzing instead of acting
work.body: A thorough analysis can feel safe and delay a simple step. Write the next action in one sentence and do it before more research.

work.label: WATCH OUT
work.headline: Dismissing a colleague's enthusiasm
work.body: A dry reaction can read as disapproval. Say one thing you like about the idea before the doubts.

work.label: GO EASY ON
work.headline: Keeping doubts to yourself
work.body: Quiet concerns tend to grow when unspoken. Go easy on silence: name one doubt in a calm sentence at the next meeting.

work.label: WATCH OUT
work.headline: Waiting for perfect information
work.body: It is easy to believe one more fact would settle it. Set a decision date and act on what you have by then.
work.link: the 7's habit of waiting for certainty

relationships.label: WATCH OUT
relationships.headline: Going silent without saying why
relationships.body: You may notice you retreat and others guess what happened. Send a short note: 'I need quiet; I plan to be back on Friday.'

relationships.label: GO EASY ON
relationships.headline: Being hard to reach
relationships.body: A 7 year can drift from messages and plans. Go easy on the silence: reply to one waiting message today.

relationships.label: AVOID
relationships.headline: Keeping your real thoughts hidden
relationships.body: Privacy is healthy and secrecy from people close to you tends to feel like distance. Tell one friend something you have kept to yourself.

relationships.label: WATCH OUT
relationships.headline: Dry remarks that land as cold
relationships.body: A wry comment may be read as dismissal. Add a warm sentence after it.

relationships.label: GO EASY ON
relationships.headline: Analyzing a friend instead of listening
relationships.body: It is easy to study a person's words for meaning. Go easy: reflect back what they said and ask if you heard it right.

relationships.label: WATCH OUT
relationships.headline: Not explaining your need for quiet
relationships.body: Time alone is healthy; unexplained, it can look like rejection. Tell people when you are recharging and when you are available.

energy.label: WATCH OUT
energy.headline: Staying up thinking in circles
energy.body: A 7 year tends to bring late-night mental loops. Write the question on paper and let it wait until morning.

energy.label: GO EASY ON
energy.headline: Too much time alone
energy.body: Solitude restores you and, in excess, can drain. Go easy: put one short social plan in the week.

energy.label: AVOID
energy.headline: Skipping fresh air and company
energy.body: Staying in with your thoughts can feel peaceful and tends to dull the mood. Take a twenty-minute walk and notice what changes.

energy.label: WATCH OUT
energy.headline: Mental fatigue from rumination
energy.body: You may notice your mind is tired before your body. Switch to something with your hands for half an hour.

energy.label: GO EASY ON
energy.headline: Refusing every group break
energy.body: Passing on shared breaks can keep your energy and your connections low. Go easy: join one a week.

energy.label: WATCH OUT
energy.headline: Researching late into the evening
energy.body: Deep reading can be absorbing and costly to rest. Set a time to close the book and keep it.

mind.label: WATCH OUT
mind.headline: Waiting for certainty that does not come
mind.body: A 7 year tends to hold out for an answer that is complete. Write down the best available answer and act on it for a month.
mind.link: the 7's habit of waiting for certainty

mind.label: GO EASY ON
mind.headline: Turning cynical too fast
mind.body: Skepticism is useful and can slide into assuming the worst. Go easy: name one thing that might work before you list what may not.

mind.label: AVOID
mind.headline: Doubting a simple good thing
mind.body: A plain good outcome can look too easy to trust. Accept it for a day before you look for the catch.

mind.label: WATCH OUT
mind.headline: Over-analyzing a feeling
mind.body: You may notice you study a feeling instead of having it. Name it in one word and let it be.

mind.label: GO EASY ON
mind.headline: Replaying a conversation
mind.body: Going over what was said can feel like understanding. Go easy: pick one thing to ask next time and drop the rest.

mind.label: WATCH OUT
mind.headline: Keeping insights to yourself
mind.body: Good thinking often stays private. Share one idea this month, even if it is only half formed.

money.label: WATCH OUT
money.headline: Measuring your worth by a number
money.body: An 8 year can tie self-respect to income or status. Write down three things you value that no figure can show, and read them when the number dips.
money.link: the 8's habit of measuring worth by output

money.label: GO EASY ON
money.headline: Spending to show success
money.body: It is easy to buy the visible proof that you are doing well. Go easy: wait a week on any purchase meant mainly for display.

money.label: AVOID
money.headline: Controlling every shared account
money.body: Holding all the money decisions can feel like responsibility and tends to shut others out. Hand one shared decision to the other person completely.

money.label: WATCH OUT
money.headline: Keeping a tally of who owes what
money.body: You may notice an exact count of every favor and share. Pick one small debt and forgive it out loud.

money.label: GO EASY ON
money.headline: Working extra hours to hit a figure
money.body: Chasing a target can swallow evenings and weekends. Go easy: set the hours you plan to give it and let the figure follow.

money.label: WATCH OUT
money.headline: Treating a gift as an obligation
money.body: An 8 year tends to hear a kindness as a debt. Say 'thank you' and nothing about repaying it.

work.label: WATCH OUT
work.headline: Taking on a bigger load again
work.body: Effort comes naturally in an 8 year and the load can keep growing. Name one commitment to drop or hand off before you add a new one.

work.label: GO EASY ON
work.headline: Managing every detail yourself
work.body: Control can look like competence and tends to slow a team. Go easy: delegate one task with real authority and let it be done differently.

work.label: AVOID
work.headline: Judging people by output alone
work.body: Measuring colleagues by results can hide what they carry. Ask how someone is before you ask how the work is going.

work.label: WATCH OUT
work.headline: A harsh tone when you are stretched
work.body: Pressure may sharpen your voice. When you notice it, take a minute before you send the message.

work.label: GO EASY ON
work.headline: No stop time on the week
work.body: Without a limit, work tends to expand to fill everything. Go easy: set a finishing hour for each day and keep it.

work.label: WATCH OUT
work.headline: Taking all the credit or all the blame
work.body: An 8 year tends to carry the outcome alone. Name two people who contributed and say what they did.

relationships.label: WATCH OUT
relationships.headline: Managing the people you love
relationships.body: You may notice you organize partners and friends like projects. Ask what they would like before you propose the plan.

relationships.label: GO EASY ON
relationships.headline: Hardness when you are stressed
relationships.body: Stress can turn your voice firm and your patience short. Go easy: say 'I am under pressure, not angry at you' when it happens.

relationships.label: AVOID
relationships.headline: Keeping score in a close relationship
relationships.body: A running count of who did more tends to sour affection. Say one thing you appreciate before you raise one thing that is uneven.

relationships.label: WATCH OUT
relationships.headline: Impatience with someone's feelings
relationships.body: Feelings can look inefficient to an 8. Listen for two minutes without offering a fix.

relationships.label: GO EASY ON
relationships.headline: Showing love only by providing
relationships.body: Providing is real care and can stand in for presence. Go easy: spend an hour with someone with no agenda.
relationships.link: the 8's habit of showing care through work

relationships.label: WATCH OUT
relationships.headline: Pushing a partner's pace
relationships.body: It is easy to expect others to match your speed. Ask what pace feels right to them.

energy.label: WATCH OUT
energy.headline: Pushing past your limit
energy.body: An 8 year leans on effort and control. Pick a stop time each day and keep it, even if the list is not done.

energy.label: GO EASY ON
energy.headline: Calling rest a reward
energy.body: You may notice rest feels like something to earn. Go easy: schedule recovery before the push, not after.
energy.link: the 8's habit of measuring worth by output

energy.label: AVOID
energy.headline: Working through the weekend by default
energy.body: Weekend work can start as a one-off and become a pattern. Pick one day that stays free of work, and treat it as fixed.

energy.label: WATCH OUT
energy.headline: Fuelling the day on pressure
energy.body: Stress can feel like energy for a while. Notice when it starts to run you and take a short walk.

energy.label: GO EASY ON
energy.headline: Skipping breaks to finish faster
energy.body: Skipped breaks tend to slow the afternoon. Go easy: take a real ten-minute break before the next big task.

energy.label: WATCH OUT
energy.headline: Carrying everyone's problems
energy.body: An 8 year can make you the person who handles it all. Ask one person to take one problem completely.

mind.label: WATCH OUT
mind.headline: Judging the year by what was produced
mind.body: You may notice every week gets graded on output. Write down one thing that mattered and produced nothing.
mind.link: the 8's habit of measuring worth by output

mind.label: GO EASY ON
mind.headline: A harsh inner critic
mind.body: The voice that drives you can also belittle you. Go easy: say to yourself what you would say to a good colleague.

mind.label: AVOID
mind.headline: Needing to control every outcome
mind.body: Wanting certainty can feel like diligence and tends to exhaust. Name one thing that is out of your hands and let it go.

mind.label: WATCH OUT
mind.headline: Impatience with a slower pace
mind.body: An 8 year tends to speed up when others slow down. Ask what the slower pace is protecting.

mind.label: GO EASY ON
mind.headline: Comparing results with others
mind.body: It is easy to measure yourself against whoever is ahead. Go easy: compare this season with your own last one.

mind.label: WATCH OUT
mind.headline: Resisting a lighter week
mind.body: You may notice a lighter schedule feels like falling behind. Plan one on purpose and see what changes.

money.label: WATCH OUT
money.headline: Giving more than you can afford
money.body: A 9 year can make generosity feel like duty. Decide a giving amount before you are asked, and keep to it even when the cause is moving.

money.label: GO EASY ON
money.headline: Small gifts scattered everywhere
money.body: Many small donations can feel kind and hard to track. Go easy: pick two causes to support properly and say no to the rest.

money.label: AVOID
money.headline: Giving until you resent it
money.body: Giving beyond your means tends to turn into bitterness. If you notice the sourness, lower the amount and say so plainly.

money.label: WATCH OUT
money.headline: Not looking at your own accounts
money.body: Attention to others' needs can crowd out your own. Set a monthly twenty minutes to read your own figures.
money.link: the 9's detachment from its own needs

money.label: GO EASY ON
money.headline: Keeping things out of loyalty
money.body: You may hold on to items, subscriptions or commitments because ending them feels disloyal. Go easy: choose one to close this season.

money.label: WATCH OUT
money.headline: Working unpaid and resenting it
money.body: A 9 year tends to pull toward unpaid effort. Name what you are giving, set a limit, and say it aloud.

work.label: WATCH OUT
work.headline: A yes to every cause at work
work.body: A 9 year can draw you into every worthy project. Choose one to give real time to and decline the rest kindly.

work.label: GO EASY ON
work.headline: Staying on a finished project
work.body: It is easy to keep tending something after its season. Go easy: write what 'finished' means and close it.

work.label: AVOID
work.headline: Giving credit away until nothing remains
work.body: Passing every compliment on can keep your work unseen. Say what you contributed in one plain sentence.

work.label: WATCH OUT
work.headline: Bitterness about unrecognized effort
work.body: You may notice resentment building when your work goes unthanked. Ask for what you need before it hardens.

work.label: GO EASY ON
work.headline: Taking on unpaid extras
work.body: A good cause can become a second job. Go easy: set the hours you offer and write them down.

work.label: WATCH OUT
work.headline: Detaching when it gets personal
work.body: A wide view can slip into distance. When a colleague raises something sensitive, stay for five minutes and listen.

relationships.label: WATCH OUT
relationships.headline: Staying loyal past the point of use
relationships.body: A 9 year can make you stay in something long after it works. Ask yourself what would keep it alive, and what you would need for that.

relationships.label: GO EASY ON
relationships.headline: Giving without ever asking
relationships.body: Generosity can hide a wish to be asked how you are. Go easy: state one need to someone close.

relationships.label: AVOID
relationships.headline: Stepping back instead of speaking up
relationships.body: Detachment can feel like calm and often hides hurt. Say what is bothering you in one honest sentence.

relationships.label: WATCH OUT
relationships.headline: Carrying an old grievance
relationships.body: You may notice a past hurt resurfacing. Write the story down, then decide whether you still need it.

relationships.label: GO EASY ON
relationships.headline: Loving the idea of a person
relationships.body: It is easy to see someone's potential more than their present. Go easy: describe them as they are now.

relationships.label: WATCH OUT
relationships.headline: Trying to rescue everyone
relationships.body: A 9 year pulls toward helping people who have not asked. Ask 'what would help?' and let them answer.

energy.label: WATCH OUT
energy.headline: Giving until your reserves run out
energy.body: A 9 year can drain you slowly. Decide in advance what you can offer this week and stop there.

energy.label: GO EASY ON
energy.headline: A cause with no off switch
energy.body: Worthy work can take every evening. Go easy: pick one day a week when it is off the table.
energy.link: the 9's habit of living for a cause

energy.label: AVOID
energy.headline: Ignoring your own needs for others
energy.body: Putting everyone first can feel noble and tends to wear thin. Do one thing for yourself every day, however small.

energy.label: WATCH OUT
energy.headline: A sadness you have not named
energy.body: Endings can bring a heaviness that is easy to push past. Take ten minutes to sit with it and write one sentence.
energy.link: the 9's detachment from its own feelings

energy.label: GO EASY ON
energy.headline: No space for joy
energy.body: A serious year can crowd out play. Go easy: add one small, purely enjoyable thing a week.
energy.link: the 9's habit of living for a cause

energy.label: WATCH OUT
energy.headline: Carrying every ending
energy.body: A 9 year tends to bring many closings. Mark each one with a small ritual, then put it down.

mind.label: WATCH OUT
mind.headline: Replaying old hurts
mind.body: A 9 year can bring old grievances back. When one returns, ask whether it is still useful, and write a line to set it down.

mind.label: GO EASY ON
mind.headline: Wide view, no foothold
mind.body: Seeing everything can make you unsure where to act. Go easy: choose one small thing that is yours to do.

mind.label: AVOID
mind.headline: Feeling that nobody understands
mind.body: Feeling unseen can slide into bitterness. Tell one person what you wish they knew.

mind.label: WATCH OUT
mind.headline: Choosing the cause over your own life
mind.body: You may notice your own plans waiting while the cause gets everything. Write one personal goal and give it a date.
mind.link: the 9's habit of living for a cause

mind.label: GO EASY ON
mind.headline: Guilt about unfinished things
mind.body: It is easy to feel bad about what is not done. Go easy: list three things, finish one, and release the rest.

mind.label: WATCH OUT
mind.headline: Holding yourself apart
mind.body: A wide perspective can turn into distance. Share one personal thing with someone this month.
